children: On-chain investigator ZachXBT accused X user Mr Austin Fine, known as @xmrfine, of converting stolen crypto assets belonging to victim Malone into luxury goods for a fee and suggested he may have informed on others. According to ChainCatcher, ZachXBT said he would treat the matter as a complete break until the victim is compensated and that it could negatively affect the user's current and future brand partnerships.
ZachXBT later said he had traced part of the funds through Monero to TBTFW, a luxury car dealer in Los Angeles, where the money was used to buy a vehicle.

title: ZachXBT Accuses @xmrfine of Converting Stolen Crypto Into Luxury Goods
